name: forseti
description: Forseti verify-gate for Claude Code. After each C edit, ESBMC verifies the edited function at the function level (memory safety, overflow, bounds — no harness needed) and the turn cannot end until every touched unit is VERIFIED up to k. A property-check subagent (propose -> check) adds semantic/functional property checking on demand, surfaced loudly (non-blocking) at Stop. Forseti returns a verdict; the hooks own the fix loop.
